pr_title: Bug 4031 Change data depending on configuration
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Precalculate Raw and Adjusted data for `FileSystemDataFeed`. Choose one of them on demand depending on configuration settings.

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #4031

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
Options require raw data mode but by default, equities use adjusted data mode. When an option is added and the underlying equity has already been added to Lean, it will set the data mode to raw but the data of the underlying might of already been all loaded by the workers so this change has no effect in the data itself.

#### Requires Documentation Change
<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
N/A

#### How Has This Been Tested?
<!--- Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. -->
<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->

- Manual testing
- Unit tests
- Benchmarks. Algorithhms are run on Intel i5 6200u, 8GB RAM, SSD. Use all SPY minute resolution for both BasicTemplateBenchmark and EmptyMinute400EquityBenchmark (hardcoded data source `equity\usa\minute\spy`). Due to test requirements we also need to provide factor files for all Symbols, so I hardcoded SPY factor file too. Results are below

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/91224421-c18b5c80-e72a-11ea-878d-41bb4933fd7b.png)

issue_context.title: Options added after Initialize with already existing equity
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
- Options added after Initialize with already existing equity are deterministic and work correctly.
#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
- Options require raw data mode but by default, equities use adjusted data mode. When an option is added and the underlying equity has already been added to Lean, it will set the data mode to raw https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Algorithm/QCAlgorithm.Universe.cs#L78 `ConfigureUnderlyingSecurity()`, but the data of the underlying might of already been all loaded by the workers so this change has no effect in the data itself.

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
- Existing equity subscription should be removed/discarded and a new subscription should be added using the raw data mode
#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->
See AddRemoveOptionUniverseRegressionAlgorithm
#### System Information
<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->
N/A

review_comments: Let's simplify this behavior so we only support for now going from Any data mode -> Raw and other cases throw invalid operation exception 👍
I think `else` should probably throw an exception too?
